title: F7C Hornet Mk II (Anvil Aerospace, Star Citizen)

sources.title: F7C Hornet Mk II (Star Citizen Wiki)
Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The F7C Hornet Mk II is the civilian version of Anvil's medium fighter in Star Citizen. The pilot sits alone under a framed canopy. The common controls apply unchanged.

panels.name: F7C Hornet Mk II: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the F7C Hornet Mk II's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot gun mounts (two)
controls.text: The F7C Hornet Mk II has two mounts for pilot guns. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (eight missiles)
controls.text: Eight missiles hang in the F7C Hornet Mk II's racks. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

controls.name: Cargo (2 SCU)
controls.text: A small space holds 2 SCU of cargo. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.
